trg_turn_agent_execution_scope.source:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_turn_agent_execution_scope
        BEFORE INSERT ON turn_agent_execution
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM turns turn_row
          JOIN sessions session_row ON session_row.id=turn_row.session_id
          JOIN workspaces workspace_row
            ON workspace_row.id=session_row.workspace_id AND workspace_row.status='active'
          JOIN users actor ON actor.id=session_row.user_id AND actor.status='active'
          JOIN team_members member
            ON member.team_id=workspace_row.team_id AND member.user_id=actor.id
           AND member.status='active'
          JOIN teams team ON team.id=workspace_row.team_id AND team.status='active'
          WHERE turn_row.id=NEW.turn_id
            AND turn_row.status='running'
            AND workspace_row.team_id=NEW.team_id
        ) OR (
          NEW.parent_execution_id IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM turn_agent_execution parent
            WHERE parent.id=NEW.parent_execution_id
              AND parent.team_id=NEW.team_id
              AND parent.turn_id=NEW.turn_id
          )
        )
        BEGIN
          SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'turn Agent execution scope mismatch');
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_document_job_admission BEFORE INSERT ON document_jobs
        WHEN NEW.status<>'queued' OR NEW.phase<>'resolving'
          OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_jobs WHERE id=NEW.id OR
            (team_id=NEW.team_id AND workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND requested_by=NEW.requested_by AND idempotency_key=NEW.idempotency_key))
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_turn_user_sources u JOIN turns t ON t.id=u.turn_id
            JOIN sessions s ON s.id=t.session_id JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=s.workspace_id
            JOIN teams team ON team.id=w.team_id JOIN users actor ON actor.id=s.user_id
            JOIN team_members tm ON tm.team_id=w.team_id AND tm.user_id=s.user_id
            JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=w.id AND wm.user_id=s.user_id
            WHERE u.turn_id=NEW.origin_turn_id AND u.session_id=NEW.session_id AND s.id=NEW.session_id
              AND u.user_id=NEW.requested_by AND s.user_id=NEW.requested_by
              AND u.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND s.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
              AND w.team_id=NEW.team_id AND u.user_text=t.user_text
              AND t.status='running' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.status='active'
              AND team.status='active' AND actor.status='active' AND tm.status='active' AND wm.status='active')
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document admission unavailable'); END

trg_scheduled_agent_binding_insert.source:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_scheduled_agent_binding_insert
        BEFORE INSERT ON scheduled_job_agent_binding
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM scheduled_jobs job
          JOIN workspaces workspace
            ON workspace.id=job.workspace_id AND workspace.status='active'
          JOIN users confirmer
            ON confirmer.id=NEW.confirmed_by AND confirmer.status='active'
          JOIN team_members member
            ON member.team_id=workspace.team_id
           AND member.user_id=NEW.confirmed_by AND member.status='active'
          WHERE job.id=NEW.job_id AND job.user_id=NEW.confirmed_by
        ) OR (
          NEW.agent_source_kind='team' AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scheduled_jobs job
            JOIN workspaces workspace ON workspace.id=job.workspace_id
            JOIN agent_assignment assignment
              ON assignment.id=NEW.assignment_id
             AND assignment.team_id=workspace.team_id
             AND assignment.user_id=job.user_id
             AND assignment.agent_id=NEW.agent_id
             AND assignment.agent_source_kind='team'
             AND assignment.personal_state='active'
             AND assignment.access_state='granted'
            JOIN team_subagent agent
              ON agent.team_id=workspace.team_id AND agent.id=NEW.agent_id
             AND agent.status='enabled' AND agent.lifecycle_state='active'
             AND agent.definition_mode='revisioned'
             AND agent.live_revision_id=NEW.revision_ref
             AND agent.live_release_id=NEW.release_id
            JOIN team_subagent_release release
              ON release.team_id=workspace.team_id
             AND release.subagent_id=NEW.agent_id
             AND release.id=NEW.release_id
             AND release.revision_id=NEW.revision_ref
             AND release.capability_fingerprint=NEW.capability_fingerprint
             AND release.dependency_fingerprint=NEW.dependency_fingerprint
            JOIN team_subagent_revision agent_revision
              ON agent_revision.team_id=release.team_id
             AND agent_revision.subagent_id=release.subagent_id
             AND agent_revision.id=release.revision_id
             AND agent_revision.capability_fingerprint=release.capability_fingerprint
             AND agent_revision.dependency_fingerprint=release.dependency_fingerprint
            JOIN agent_safety_report safety
              ON safety.team_id=release.team_id
             AND safety.agent_id=release.subagent_id
             AND safety.id=release.safety_report_id
             AND safety.subject_kind='revision'
             AND safety.subject_ref=agent_revision.id
             AND safety.dependency_fingerprint=agent_revision.dependency_fingerprint
             AND safety.status NOT IN ('blocked','unknown')
            WHERE job.id=NEW.job_id
          )
        ) OR (
          NEW.agent_source_kind='system' AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scheduled_jobs job
            JOIN workspaces workspace ON workspace.id=job.workspace_id
            JOIN system_agent_effective_revision agent_revision
              ON agent_revision.team_id=workspace.team_id
             AND agent_revision.agent_id=NEW.agent_id
             AND agent_revision.id=NEW.revision_ref
            WHERE job.id=NEW.job_id

trg_document_input_copy_admission.source:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_document_input_copy_admission BEFORE INSERT ON document_input_copies
        WHEN NEW.verified_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.cleanup_claimed_at IS NOT NULL
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_input_sets f JOIN document_jobs j ON j.id=f.job_id
            JOIN artifacts a ON a.id=NEW.artifact_id JOIN artifacts s ON s.id=NEW.source_artifact_id
            WHERE f.job_id=NEW.job_id AND f.frozen_at IS NULL AND j.status='queued'
              AND json_extract(j.request_json,'$.proposal.inputs['||NEW.input_index||'].artifact_id')=NEW.source_artifact_id
              AND json_extract(j.request_json,'$.proposal.inputs['||NEW.input_index||'].role')=NEW.role
              AND a.path=NEW.path AND a.created_by=f.owner_user_id AND a.size=NEW.size_bytes
              AND a.filename=NEW.filename AND a.mime=NEW.mime AND a.producer_kind='template_document_internal_v1'
              AND a.source='document_input' AND a.kind='tool_data' AND a.inject='list' AND a.scope='user'
              AND a.status='document_staging' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.canvas_id IS NULL AND a.created_by_turn IS NULL
              AND s.created_by=f.owner_user_id AND s.path=NEW.source_path AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status='ready'
              AND (COALESCE(s.producer_kind,'')<>'template_document_internal_v1' OR EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM document_revision_inputs ri WHERE ri.job_id=j.id AND ri.input_index=NEW.input_index
            AND ri.artifact_id=s.id AND ri.role=NEW.role AND ri.path=NEW.source_path
            AND ri.sha256=NEW.sha256 AND ri.size_bytes=NEW.size_bytes AND ri.filename=NEW.filename AND ri.mime=NEW.mime)))
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document input copy unavailable'); END

trg_ordinary_question_admission.source:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_ordinary_question_admission BEFORE INSERT ON clarification_requests
      WHEN (json_valid(NEW.resume_context_json) AND json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.__schema_version')=4) AND (
        NEW.status<>'pending' OR NEW.injected_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.continuation_generation IS NOT NULL OR NEW.continuation_owner_id IS NOT NULL
        OR NEW.answers_json IS NOT NULL OR NEW.chosen_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.kind<>'ambiguous_turn'
        OR NEW.token<>'' OR NEW.tool IS NOT NULL OR NEW.multi_select<>0 OR NEW.candidates_json<>'[]'
        OR json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.continuation.kind') IS NOT 'ordinary_lead'
        OR json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.continuation.contract') IS NOT 'ordinary-lead-question.v1'
        OR json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.continuation.card_id') IS NOT NEW.request_id
        OR json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.continuation.creation_generation') IS NOT 1
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clarification_requests WHERE turn_id=NEW.turn_id OR request_id=NEW.request_id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_jobs WHERE origin_turn_id=NEW.turn_id)
        OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turns t JOIN sessions s ON s.id=t.session_id JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=s.workspace_id
          JOIN chat_turn_spawn_dispatch d ON d.turn_id=t.id AND d.session_id=s.id
          JOIN chat_turn_user_sources u ON u.turn_id=t.id
          WHERE t.id=NEW.turn_id AND s.id=NEW.session_id AND s.user_id=NEW.user_id AND s.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
            AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.active_turn_id=t.id AND t.status='running' AND COALESCE(t.terminal_protocol_version,0)=0
            AND t.execution_generation=1 AND d.lease_execution_generation=1 AND d.state='spawned'
            AND d.owner_id=json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.continuation.creation_owner_id')
            AND d.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND julianday(d.lease_expires_at)>julianday('now')
            AND json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.team_id')=w.team_id
            AND json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.turn_id')=t.id
            AND json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.session_id')=s.id
            AND json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.user_id')=s.user_id
            AND json_extract(NEW.resume_context_json,'$.workspace_id')=s.workspace_id))
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ordinary question admission unavailable'); END

            AND d.owner_id=json_extract(?1,'$.continuation.creation_owner_id')
            AND d.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND julianday(d.lease_expires_at)>julianday('now')
            AND json_extract(?1,'$.team_id')=w.team_id

CREATE TRIGGER trg_document_canvas_admission BEFORE INSERT ON document_canvas_inputs
WHEN NEW.cleanup_claimed_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_canvas_inputs WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_jobs j JOIN sessions s ON s.id=j.session_id JOIN artifacts a ON a.id=NEW.artifact_id
   WHERE j.id=NEW.job_id AND j.status='queued' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.user_id=j.requested_by AND s.workspace_id=j.workspace_id
    AND json(json_extract(j.request_json,'$.canvas_input'))=NEW.manifest_json
    AND json_extract(j.request_json,'$.canvas_input.session_id')=j.session_id
    AND a.created_by=j.requested_by AND a.workspace_id=j.workspace_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND a.path=NEW.path AND a.size=NEW.size_bytes AND a.source='document_canvas_input'
    AND a.filename='canvas-material.json' AND a.mime='application/json'
    AND a.producer_kind='template_document_internal_v1' AND a.kind='tool_data' AND a.inject='list' AND a.scope='user'
    AND ((NEW.source_job_id IS NULL AND NEW.verified_at IS NULL AND a.status='document_staging'
       AND json_type(j.request_json,'$.proposal.canvas')='object')
      OR (NEW.source_job_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND a.status='ready'
       AND json_extract(j.request_json,'$.canvas_source_job_id')=NEW.source_job_id
       AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_canvas_inputs c JOIN document_jobs p ON p.id=c.job_id
         WHERE c.job_id=NEW.source_job_id AND c.artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id AND c.path=NEW.path AND c.sha256=NEW.sha256
          AND c.size_bytes=NEW.size_bytes AND c.manifest_json=NEW.manifest_json AND c.verified_at IS NOT NULL
          AND c.cleanup_claimed_at IS NULL AND p.team_id=j.team_id AND p.workspace_id=j.workspace_id
          AND p.requested_by=j.requested_by AND p.session_id=j.session_id
          AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_revisions r WHERE r.parent_job_id=p.id AND r.job_id=j.id)
            OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_continuations r WHERE r.parent_job_id=p.id AND r.job_id=j.id))))))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document Canvas input unavailable'); END

          WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_deletion_rows r JOIN account_deletions d ON d.operation_id=r.operation_id
            WHERE r.table_name='document_canvas_inputs' AND r.row_key=json_array(OLD.job_id)
              AND d.state='purging' AND julianday(d.purge_after)<=julianday('now') AND d.lease_owner IS NOT NULL
              AND julianday(d.lease_expires_at)>julianday('now')
              AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id=d.user_id AND u.status='deleted'))
          BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document Canvas identity is retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_document_ref_admission BEFORE INSERT ON document_artifact_refs

          OR NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_input_copies c JOIN document_input_sets f ON f.job_id=c.job_id
            JOIN document_jobs j ON j.id=f.job_id JOIN artifacts a ON a.id=c.artifact_id
            WHERE c.artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id AND c.job_id=NEW.owner_id AND c.sha256=NEW.artifact_sha256
              AND NEW.ref_key='input:'||c.source_artifact_id AND f.team_id=NEW.team_id AND f.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
              AND f.owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND j.status='queued' AND c.cleanup_claimed_at IS NULL
              AND a.path=c.path AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_canvas_inputs c JOIN document_jobs j ON j.id=c.job_id
                JOIN artifacts a ON a.id=c.artifact_id WHERE c.job_id=NEW.owner_id AND c.artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id
                 AND c.sha256=NEW.artifact_sha256 AND NEW.ref_key='canvas' AND c.cleanup_claimed_at IS NULL
                 AND j.team_id=NEW.team_id AND j.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND j.requested_by=NEW.owner_user_id
                 AND j.status='queued' AND a.path=c.path AND a.deleted_at IS NULL))
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document reference unavailable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_model_context_generation_scope BEFORE INSERT ON model_context_generations
      WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_agent_execution e JOIN turns t ON t.id=e.turn_id
        JOIN sessions s ON s.id=t.session_id JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=s.workspace_id
        WHERE e.id=NEW.execution_id AND t.id=NEW.turn_id AND s.id=NEW.session_id
          AND e.team_id=w.team_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND ((COALESCE(t.terminal_protocol_version,0)=0 AND t.execution_generation=NEW.worker_generation)
            OR (t.terminal_protocol_version=1 AND t.current_generation=NEW.worker_generation)))
      OR (NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_context_generations p
        WHERE p.id=NEW.parent_id AND p.session_id=NEW.session_id AND p.execution_id=NEW.execution_id AND p.lane=NEW.lane))
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'model context generation scope mismatch'); END

        JOIN sessions s ON s.id=t.session_id JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=s.workspace_id
        WHERE e.id=?1 AND t.id=?2 AND s.id=?3
          AND e.team_id=w.team_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND ((COALESCE(t.terminal_protocol_version,0)=0 AND t.execution_generation=?4)
            OR (t.terminal_protocol_version=1 AND t.current_generation=?4)))

        WHERE p.id=?5 AND p.session_id=?3 AND p.execution_id=?1 AND p.lane=?6))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

 SELECT 1 FROM clarification_requests q

 AND d.state='spawned' AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.lease_kind='resume'

CREATE TRIGGER trg_reference_primary_completion BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON turns
      WHEN NEW.status='completed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_plans p WHERE p.turn_id=NEW.id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_resolutions r JOIN turn_agent_binding b ON b.turn_id=r.turn_id
          JOIN turn_agent_execution e ON e.id=r.execution_id JOIN chat_reference_evidence o
            ON o.turn_id=r.turn_id AND o.execution_id=e.id AND o.resolution_seq=r.resolution_seq
          WHERE r.turn_id=NEW.id AND (r.resolution_seq=1 OR (r.resolution_seq=2 AND json_extract(r.composition_json,'$.runtime_policy')='lead-delegation.v1')) AND (r.created_generation=NEW.execution_generation OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM document_jobs j
 JOIN document_dispatches admission ON admission.job_id=j.id
 JOIN turn_capability_execution capability ON capability.id=admission.capability_execution_id
 JOIN document_turn_dispatches original ON original.job_id=j.id
 JOIN document_planning_attempts first ON first.job_id=j.id AND first.attempt_no=1
 JOIN clarification_document_continuations card ON card.job_id=j.id
 JOIN clarification_requests question ON question.request_id=card.card_id
 JOIN document_planning_attempts resumed ON resumed.job_id=j.id AND resumed.attempt_no=2
 JOIN document_executions document ON document.job_id=j.id
 JOIN sessions session ON session.id=j.session_id
 JOIN workspaces space ON space.id=j.workspace_id
 JOIN chat_turn_spawn_dispatch lease ON lease.turn_id=j.origin_turn_id
 WHERE j.origin_turn_id=NEW.id AND j.session_id=NEW.session_id AND j.status='queued'
 AND session.user_id=j.requested_by AND session.workspace_id=j.workspace_id AND space.team_id=j.team_id
 AND session.deleted_at IS NULL AND session.active_turn_id=NEW.id
 AND capability.agent_execution_id=e.id AND capability.turn_id=NEW.id AND capability.team_id=j.team_id
 AND capability.status='completed' AND capability.output_contract=CASE WHEN admission.profile='docx-script-worker-v1' THEN 'document.admission.v2' ELSE 'document.admission.v1' END
 AND card.turn_id=NEW.id AND card.creation_generation=original.creation_generation
 AND card.creation_owner_id=original.owner_id AND first.creation_generation=original.creation_generation
 AND first.owner_id=original.owner_id AND first.checkpoint_digest=card.checkpoint_digest
 AND j.user_source_sha256=original.source_hash AND card.source_hash=original.source_hash
 AND card.runtime_snapshot_digest=original.runtime_snapshot_digest
 AND question.turn_id=NEW.id AND question.session_id=j.session_id
 AND question.user_id=j.requested_by AND question.workspace_id=j.workspace_id AND question.status='resolved'
 AND card.reserved_generation=NEW.execution_generation AND card.consumed_generation=NEW.execution_generation
 AND NEW.execution_generation>original.creation_generation AND o.created_generation=original.creation_generation
 AND o.retention_state='available'
 AND resumed.card_id=card.card_id AND resumed.creation_generation=card.consumed_generation
 AND resumed.owner_id=card.consumed_owner_id AND document.owner=card.consumed_owner_id
 AND document.state IN ('review','published')
 AND lease.session_id=j.session_id AND lease.state='spawned' AND lease.lease_kind='resume'
 AND lease.owner_id=card.consumed_owner_id AND lease.lease_execution_generation=card.consumed_generation
 AND lease.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND julianday(lease.lease_expires_at)>julianday('now')
) OR (EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_plans plan
 JOIN chat_reference_resolutions original ON original.turn_id=plan.turn_id AND original.resolution_seq=1
 JOIN chat_reference_resolutions actual ON actual.turn_id=plan.turn_id AND actual.resolution_seq=2
 JOIN chat_reference_evidence started ON started.turn_id=plan.turn_id AND started.execution_id=actual.execution_id
 JOIN clarification_requests card ON card.turn_id=plan.turn_id
 JOIN chat_turn_spawn_dispatch dispatch ON dispatch.turn_id=plan.turn_id
 JOIN chat_reference_lead_postdispatch_attempts attempt ON attempt.turn_id=plan.turn_id
 WHERE plan.turn_id=r.turn_id AND json_extract(plan.plan_json,'$.orchestration_contract')='lead-delegation.v1'
 AND r.execution_id=actual.execution_id AND r.resolution_seq IN (1,2)
 AND r.composition_digest=CASE WHEN r.resolution_seq=1 THEN original.composition_digest ELSE actual.composition_digest END
 AND actual.created_generation=1 AND json_extract(actual.composition_json,'$.runtime_policy')='lead-delegation.v1'
 AND started.resolution_seq=2 AND started.kind='delegate_started' AND started.created_generation=1
 AND started.subagent_id=o.subagent_id AND NEW.execution_generation=2
 AND card.status='resolved' AND card.session_id=dispatch.session_id
 AND attempt.clarification_id=card.request_id AND attempt.execution_id=actual.execution_id
 AND attempt.generation=NEW.execution_generation AND attempt.owner_id=dispatch.owner_id
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.reference_continuation.contract')='reference-lead-postdispatch.v1'

 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.reference_continuation.composition_digest')=original.composition_digest
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.reference_continuation.delegation_digest')=actual.composition_digest
 AND dispatch.state='spawned' AND dispatch.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND dispatch.lease_kind='resume'
 AND dispatch.lease_execution_generation=NEW.execution_generation AND dispatch.cancel_requested_at IS NULL
 AND julianday(dispatch.lease_expires_at)>julianday('now')
) OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_plans plan
 JOIN chat_reference_resolutions original ON original.turn_id=plan.turn_id AND original.resolution_seq=1
 JOIN chat_reference_resolutions actual ON actual.turn_id=plan.turn_id AND actual.resolution_seq=2

 AND EXISTS (

 JOIN clarification_requests lead ON lead.request_id=json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.prior_request_id')

 AND actual.created_generation>1 AND started.created_generation=actual.created_generation
 AND started.content_hash=json_extract(actual.composition_json,'$.task_hash')
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.contract')='effect-free-questions.v1'
 AND json_type(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.round')='integer'
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.round') IN (2,3)
 AND json_type(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.generation')='integer'
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.generation')=actual.created_generation
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.session_id')=session.id
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.user_id')=session.user_id
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.workspace_id')=session.workspace_id
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.team_id')=space.team_id
 AND json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.user_text')=source.user_text
 AND lead.turn_id=plan.turn_id AND lead.session_id=session.id
 AND lead.user_id=session.user_id AND lead.workspace_id=session.workspace_id
 AND lead.status='resolved' AND lead.kind='ambiguous_turn' AND lead.token='' AND COALESCE(lead.tool,'')=''
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.reference_continuation.contract')='reference-lead-predispatch.v1'
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.reference_continuation.execution_id')=actual.execution_id
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.reference_continuation.source_hash')=plan.source_hash
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.reference_continuation.composition_digest')=original.composition_digest
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.session_id')=session.id
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.user_id')=session.user_id
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.workspace_id')=session.workspace_id
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.team_id')=space.team_id
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.user_text')=source.user_text
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.contract')='effect-free-questions.v1'
 AND json_type(lead.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.round')='integer'
 AND json_type(lead.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.generation')='integer'
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.round')=json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.round')-1
 AND json_extract(lead.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.generation')<actual.created_generation
 AND (SELECT MAX(json_extract(notice.payload_json,'$.execution_generation')) FROM turn_events notice
 WHERE notice.turn_id=plan.turn_id AND notice.event_type='turn.resumed' AND json_valid(notice.payload_json)
 AND json_type(notice.payload_json,'$.execution_generation')='integer'

     =json_extract(card.resume_context_json,'$.question_round.round')-1

CREATE TRIGGER trg_reference_skill_extension_composition BEFORE INSERT ON chat_reference_resolutions
WHEN json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.runtime_policy')='initial-primary-skill-extension.v1'
AND json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.method_reference') IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_content_snapshots c JOIN turn_agent_execution e ON e.id=NEW.execution_id
 JOIN chat_turn_spawn_dispatch d ON d.turn_id=NEW.turn_id
 WHERE c.turn_id=NEW.turn_id AND c.content_key='reference:primary:skill-extension'
 AND c.retention_state='available' AND c.created_generation=NEW.created_generation
 AND c.descriptor_json=json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.content')
 AND json_extract(c.descriptor_json,'$.content_kind')='skill_extension'
 AND json_extract(c.descriptor_json,'$.node_id') IS json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.node_id')
 AND json_extract(c.descriptor_json,'$.resource')=json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.resource')
 AND json_extract(c.descriptor_json,'$.resource.kind')='agent'
 AND json_extract(c.descriptor_json,'$.materialization_hash')=json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.receiver_digest')

 AND e.agent_source_kind='team'
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_subagent_revision_extensions x WHERE x.team_id=e.team_id AND x.agent_id=e.agent_id
   AND x.revision_ref=e.revision_ref AND x.definition_hash=json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.baseline.source_definition_hash')
   AND x.extension_policy_digest=json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.extension_policy_digest'))
 AND length(json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.extension_digest'))=71
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.composition_json,'$.members') m WHERE json_extract(m.value,'$.provenance')='readonly_extension')
 AND NEW.resolution_seq=1 AND NEW.idempotency_key='reference:primary'
 AND (e.status='running' OR (e.status='admitted' AND e.started_at IS NULL
 AND json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.orchestration_contract')='lead-delegation.v1'
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_plans rp WHERE rp.turn_id=NEW.turn_id
 AND json_extract(rp.plan_json,'$.orchestration_contract')='lead-delegation.v1'))) AND d.state='spawned' AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL
 AND (
  (d.dispatch_kind='start' AND d.parent_turn_id IS NULL)
  OR (
    d.dispatch_kind='follow_up' AND d.parent_turn_id IS NOT NULL
    AND d.source_submission_id IS NOT NULL
    AND d.source_submission_ids_json=json_array(d.source_submission_id)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_queued_inputs q
      JOIN sessions qs ON qs.id=q.session_id
      JOIN workspaces qw ON qw.id=qs.workspace_id
      JOIN turns qp ON qp.id=q.accepted_parent_turn_id
      JOIN turns qc ON qc.id=q.materialized_turn_id
      JOIN turns qh ON qh.id=d.parent_turn_id AND qh.session_id=q.session_id
      WHERE q.team_id=qw.team_id AND q.user_id=qs.user_id
        AND q.workspace_id=qs.workspace_id
        AND q.session_id=d.session_id
        AND q.client_submission_id=d.source_submission_id
        AND EXISTS (
          WITH RECURSIVE lineage(turn_id) AS (
            SELECT qh.id
            UNION
            SELECT prior.parent_turn_id FROM chat_turn_spawn_dispatch prior
            JOIN lineage ON lineage.turn_id=prior.turn_id
            JOIN turns ancestor ON ancestor.id=prior.parent_turn_id AND ancestor.session_id=q.session_id
            WHERE prior.session_id=q.session_id AND prior.dispatch_kind='follow_up'
              AND prior.turn_id<>q.accepted_parent_turn_id
          )
          SELECT 1 FROM lineage WHERE turn_id=q.accepted_parent_turn_id
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineage WHERE turn_id=q.materialized_turn_id)
        )
        AND q.state='materialized'
        AND q.materialized_turn_id=d.turn_id
        AND qp.session_id=q.session_id
        AND qc.session_id=q.session_id
    )
  )
) AND d.lease_kind='turn'
 AND d.lease_execution_generation=NEW.created_generation AND NEW.created_generation=1
 AND json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.receiver_status')='admitted'
 AND json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.parameter_source')='initial-source.v1'
 AND json_extract(NEW.composition_json,'$.render_contract')='skill-read-json.v1'
 AND json_type(NEW.composition_json,'$.members')='array'
 AND json_array_length(NEW.composition_json,'$.members') BETWEEN 1 AND 32
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.composition_json,'$.members') m WHERE COALESCE(
   json_extract(m.value,'$.operation')='read' AND json_extract(m.value,'$.provenance') IN ('baseline','readonly_extension'),0)=0)
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'reference skill composition material mismatch'); END

            UNION
            SELECT prior.parent_turn_id FROM chat_turn_spawn_dispatch prior
            JOIN lineage ON lineage.turn_id=prior.turn_id
            JOIN turns ancestor ON ancestor.id=prior.parent_turn_id AND ancestor.session_id=q.session_id
            WHERE prior.session_id=q.session_id AND prior.dispatch_kind='follow_up'
              AND prior.turn_id<>q.accepted_parent_turn_id
          )
          SELECT 1 FROM lineage WHERE turn_id=q.accepted_parent_turn_id
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineage WHERE turn_id=q.materialized_turn_id)
        )
        AND q.state='materialized'
        AND q.materialized_turn_id=d.turn_id
        AND qp.session_id=q.session_id
        AND qc.session_id=q.session_id
    )
  )
) AND d.lease_kind='turn'
 AND d.lease_execution_generation=?4 AND ?4=1
 AND json_extract(?1,'$.receiver_status')='admitted'
 AND json_extract(?1,'$.parameter_source')='initial-source.v1'
 AND json_extract(?1,'$.render_contract')='skill-read-json.v1'
 AND json_type(?1,'$.members')='array'
 AND json_array_length(?1,'$.members') BETWEEN 1 AND 32
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?1,'$.members') m WHERE COALESCE(
   json_extract(m.value,'$.operation')='read' AND json_extract(m.value,'$.provenance') IN ('baseline','readonly_extension'),0)=0)
)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

chat_reference_plan_retention.source:
CREATE VIEW chat_reference_plan_retention AS
    SELECT p.turn_id,
      p.retention_state='available' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_content_snapshots c WHERE c.turn_id=p.turn_id
          AND (c.retention_state='purged' OR julianday(c.expires_at) IS NULL))
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_reference_evidence e WHERE e.turn_id=p.turn_id
          AND (e.retention_state='purged' OR julianday(e.expires_at) IS NULL)) AS available,
      min(julianday(p.expires_at), julianday(p.created_at) + COALESCE(
        (SELECT MIN(r.days) FROM team_reference_retention_policies r
          WHERE r.team_id=w.team_id AND r.version>=p.retention_policy_version),180),
        COALESCE((SELECT MIN(julianday(c.expires_at)) FROM chat_reference_content_snapshots c WHERE c.turn_id=p.turn_id),julianday(p.expires_at)),
        COALESCE((SELECT MIN(julianday(e.expires_at)) FROM chat_reference_evidence e WHERE e.turn_id=p.turn_id),julianday(p.expires_at))) AS deadline
    FROM chat_reference_plans p JOIN turns t ON t.id=p.turn_id
      JOIN sessions s ON s.id=t.session_id JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=s.workspace_id

chat_reference_queue_retention.source:
CREATE VIEW chat_reference_queue_retention AS
    SELECT q.team_id,q.user_id,q.client_submission_id,
      q.retention_state='available' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.available,1) AS available,
      min(julianday(q.expires_at), julianday(q.created_at) + COALESCE(
        (SELECT MIN(r.days) FROM team_reference_retention_policies r
          WHERE r.team_id=q.team_id AND r.version>=q.retention_policy_version),180),
        CASE WHEN p.turn_id IS NULL THEN julianday(q.expires_at) ELSE p.deadline END) AS deadline
    FROM chat_reference_queued_inputs q JOIN sessions s ON s.id=q.session_id
      LEFT JOIN chat_reference_plan_retention p ON p.turn_id=q.accepted_parent_turn_id

CREATE VIEW chat_reference_plan_step_scope AS
SELECT p.id AS plan_id,p.current_rev AS plan_revision,p.spec_json,s.id AS step_id,
 r.turn_id AS source_turn_id,r.execution_id AS source_execution_id,r.composition_digest,
 t.id AS execution_turn_id,e.id AS execution_id,d.owner_id,t.execution_generation AS generation,
 session.id AS session_id,session.user_id,session.workspace_id,w.team_id
FROM plans p
JOIN plan_steps s ON s.plan_id=p.id
JOIN turns t ON t.id=p.execution_turn_id AND t.session_id=p.session_id
JOIN sessions session ON session.id=t.session_id AND session.active_turn_id=t.id
JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=session.workspace_id
JOIN chat_turn_spawn_dispatch d ON d.turn_id=t.id AND d.session_id=session.id
JOIN turn_agent_execution e ON e.turn_id=t.id AND e.dispatch_source='plan'
JOIN chat_reference_resolutions r ON r.turn_id=json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.source_turn_id') AND r.resolution_seq=1
JOIN chat_reference_plans source ON source.turn_id=r.turn_id
JOIN turns original ON original.id=source.turn_id AND original.session_id=session.id
JOIN turn_agent_execution receiver ON receiver.id=r.execution_id AND receiver.turn_id=original.id
JOIN chat_reference_plan_retention retained ON retained.turn_id=source.turn_id
WHERE json_valid(p.spec_json) AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.contract')='reference-plan.v1'
 AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.revision')=p.current_rev
 AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.source_hash')=source.source_hash
 AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.source_execution_id')=receiver.id
 AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.composition_digest')=r.composition_digest
 AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.profile')=receiver.runtime_profile_name
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.main_steps') selected WHERE selected.value=s.id)
 AND json_array_length(json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.node_ids'))=json_array_length(json_extract(source.plan_json,'$.admissions'))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(source.plan_json,'$.admissions') admission WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(p.spec_json) THEN p.spec_json ELSE '{}' END,'$.reference.node_ids') node WHERE node.value=json_extract(admission.value,'$.node_id')))

 AND p.user_id=session.user_id AND p.workspace_id=session.workspace_id AND p.status='running'
 AND s.status='running' AND s.included=1 AND s.agent_name=receiver.runtime_profile_name
 AND e.dispatch_key='step:'||s.id||':rev:'||p.current_rev||':attempt:'||CAST(substr(e.dispatch_key,length('step:'||s.id||':rev:'||p.current_rev||':attempt:')+1) AS INTEGER)
 AND CAST(substr(e.dispatch_key,length('step:'||s.id||':rev:'||p.current_rev||':attempt:')+1) AS INTEGER)>0
 AND e.agent_id=receiver.agent_id AND e.team_id=w.team_id AND receiver.team_id=w.team_id
 AND e.agent_source_kind='team' AND receiver.agent_source_kind='team'
 AND e.revision_ref=receiver.revision_ref AND e.release_id=receiver.release_id
 AND e.policy_fingerprint=receiver.policy_fingerprint AND e.capability_fingerprint=receiver.capability_fingerprint
 AND e.status='running' AND receiver.status='admitted' AND receiver.started_at IS NULL
 AND json_extract(source.plan_json,'$.orchestration_contract')='lead-delegation.v1'
 AND json_extract(r.composition_json,'$.runtime_policy') IN ('initial-primary-skill-read.v1','initial-primary-skill-read.v2','initial-primary-skill-baseline.v1','initial-primary-baseline.v1','initial-primary-skill-extension.v1')
 AND r.created_generation=1 AND retained.available AND retained.deadline>julianday('now')
 AND t.status='running' AND t.execution_generation=1 AND d.lease_execution_generation=1
 AND d.state='spawned' AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.lease_kind='turn'
 AND d.dispatch_kind='start' AND d.parent_turn_id IS NULL AND d.cancel_requested_at IS NULL
 AND julianday(d.lease_expires_at)>julianday('now')
